submission.title: Transport forced cover vertices to minimum-true CNF models
submission.claim: Let a satisfy the positive edge CNF of a finite simple graph G, and suppose a minimizes the number of true variables among graph vertices. If a vertex v has degree greater than that minimum count, the selected theorem proves a(v)=true and that the same assignment satisfies the edge CNF with v-incident clauses removed. The proof transports the known vertex-cover forcing result into the list-CNF representation and directly uses the declared exact B artifact for the deletion equality.
submission.novelty: The forced-vertex fact is already established by upstream L_meta_727. Local work identifies trueVars of a satisfying assignment with a vertex cover, constructs an assignmentOf for every finite cover, proves the relevant cardinality correspondence, and transfers the minimum-cardinality hypothesis. It applies the upstream forcing theorem, then invokes B.graphCNF_delete_vertex on the original assignment. This is a formal integration of a known consequence using an explicit local dependency, not a new literature result or stronger complexity theorem.

prior_art.relationship: Exact source of the vertex-cover forcing theorem and its proof; the submitted CNF statement is a known consequence expressed through the local representation.
The upstream graph restriction theorem enters through B, whose exact selected deletion theorem is called in the C proof.
Protocol list-CNF semantics reproduced in B and reused here through that bundle, with finite true-variable cardinality defined locally.

{

  "source": "/- Modified for pnp.fun: remove unused project import and transport the
   vertex-cover forcing theorem into list-CNF minimum-true-variable semantics.
   Upstream L-meta-727: PR #979, formal contributor fededevi, Apache-2.0.
   This is a standard downstream formalization, not a claim of new discovery.
   The dependency namespace pins the exact credited B bundle bytes. -/

theorem PEqualNP.Outside.L_meta_727 : ∀ (n t : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : Fin n), (∃ S : Finset (Fin n), (∀ a b : Fin n, G.Adj a b → a ∈ S ∨ b ∈ S) ∧ S.card = t) → (∀ T : Finset (Fin n), (∀ c d : Fin n, G.Adj c d → c ∈ T ∨ d ∈ T) → t ≤ T.card) → t < (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G.Adj v u)).card → ∀ U : Finset (Fin n), (∀ e f : Fin n, G.Adj e f → e ∈ U ∨ f ∈ U) → U.card = t → v ∈ U := by
  intro n t G _ v _ _ hdeg U hU hUc
  by_contra hv
  have hsub : Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G.Adj v u) ⊆ U := by
    intro u hu
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and] at hu
    rcases hU v u hu with h | h
    · exact absurd h hv
    · exact h
  have := Finset.card_le_card hsub
  omega

open B_dd8e844ea24178cf06ed26a50bb2f4b1a253fd25ec68dc0c55e415c8d52cfd70.Federation

namespace FederationDownstream

def trueVars {n : ℕ} (a : Nat → Bool) : Finset (Fin n) :=
  Finset.univ.filter (fun u => a u.val = true)

def assignmentOf {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (k : Nat) : Bool :=
  if h : k < n then decide ((⟨k, h⟩ : Fin n) ∈ S) else false

theorem assignmentOf_at {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) (u : Fin n) :
    assignmentOf S u.val = decide (u ∈ S) := by
  simp [assignmentOf, u.isLt]

theorem trueVars_assignmentOf {n : ℕ} (S : Finset (Fin n)) :
    trueVars (assignmentOf S) = S := by
  ext u
  simp [trueVars, assignmentOf_at]

/-- A vertex of degree above the minimum number of true variables must be
    true in every minimum model. Bundle B then removes its incident clauses.
    The cardinality is only over the graph's finite vertex set. -/
theorem forced_vertex_reduction {n : ℕ} (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n))
    [DecidableRel G.Adj] (v : Fin n) (a : Nat → Bool)
    (hsat : evalCNF a (relationCNF G.Adj) = true)
    (hmin : ∀ b : Nat → Bool, evalCNF b (relationCNF G.Adj) = true →
      (trueVars (n := n) a).card ≤ (trueVars (n := n) b).card)
    (hdeg : (trueVars (n := n) a).card <
      (Finset.univ.filter (fun u : Fin n => G.Adj v u)).card) :
    a v.val = true ∧
      evalCNF a (relationCNF (fun u w => u ≠ v ∧ w ≠ v ∧ G.Adj u w)) = true := by
  have hcover : ∀ u w : Fin n, G.Adj u w →
      u ∈ trueVars (n := n) a ∨ w ∈ trueVars (n := n) a := by
    intro u w hR
    simpa [trueVars] using (relationCNF_semantics G.Adj a).mp hsat u w hR
  have hminimal : ∀ T : Finset (Fin n),
      (∀ u w : Fin n, G.Adj u w → u ∈ T ∨ w ∈ T) →
      (trueVars (n := n) a).card ≤ T.card := by
    intro T hT
    have ht : evalCNF (assignmentOf T) (relationCNF G.Adj) = true := by
      apply (relationCNF_semantics G.Adj (assignmentOf T)).mpr
      intro u w huw
      simpa [assignmentOf_at] using hT u w huw
    simpa [trueVars_assignmentOf] using hmin (assignmentOf T) ht
  have hv_mem := PEqualNP.Outside.L_meta_727 n (trueVars (n := n) a).card G v
    ⟨trueVars a, hcover, rfl⟩ hminimal hdeg (trueVars a) hcover rfl
  have hv : a v.val = true := by simpa [trueVars] using hv_mem
  have hfix : Function.update a v.val true = a := by
    funext k
    by_cases hk : k = v.val
    · subst k
      simp [hv]
    · simp [Function.update_of_ne hk]
  have reduced := B_dd8e844ea24178cf06ed26a50bb2f4b1a253fd25ec68dc0c55e415c8d52cfd70.Federation.graphCNF_delete_vertex G v a
  rw [hfix, hsat] at reduced
  exact ⟨hv, reduced.symm⟩

end FederationDownstream
